official_measurement_examples.name: Title plan semantics
official_measurement_examples.fact: HM Land Registry states the title plan shows location and general boundaries and must be read with the register and filed documents.

official_measurement_examples.name: Online ownership proof
official_measurement_examples.fact: The online search service states downloaded online information cannot itself be used as proof of ownership; an official copy is required for evidential use.

official_measurement_examples.name: General boundary rule
official_measurement_examples.fact: Practice Guide 40 says a registered estate boundary is a general boundary unless determined under section 60 of the Land Registration Act 2002.

official_measurement_examples.name: Determined boundary semantics
official_measurement_examples.fact: A determined boundary records the exact line after that line has been identified; HM Land Registry does not itself resolve the underlying neighbour dispute.

official_measurement_examples.name: Title-plan update
official_measurement_examples.fact: Practice Guide 40 supplement 5 was updated 13 July 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: INSPIRE scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: INSPIRE Index Polygons contain indicative locations and extents of registered freehold property and are a subset of HM Land Registry index polygons.

official_measurement_examples.name: INSPIRE duplicate geography
official_measurement_examples.fact: HM Land Registry notes a polygon crossing local-authority boundaries can appear in both local-authority download files.

official_measurement_examples.name: Current INSPIRE publication
official_measurement_examples.fact: The HM Land Registry download service says the July 2026 files were published 5 July 2026 and new files are published on the first Sunday of each month.

physical fence is not automatically the legal boundary
hedge position is not automatically the legal boundary
general boundary must not be converted into centimetre-accuracy geometry
determined boundary is distinct from a general boundary
boundary agreement is not automatically a determined boundary
